metadata.title: Charaka Samhita - Kalpa Sthana & Siddhi Sthana
metadata.description: Kalpa Sthana (Pharmaceutical Preparations) and Siddhi Sthana (Therapeutic Procedures) are the seventh and eighth sections of Charaka Samhita. Kalpa Sthana deals with the science of medicinal formulations including emetic and purgative drugs, their preparations, combinations and administration. Siddhi Sthana represents the pinnacle of therapeutic practice, exploring detoxification, Panchakarma procedures, complications management and successful treatment outcomes.

sthanas.description: Kalpa-sthana is the seventh section of Charaka Samhita that unveils the exquisite science of medicinal formulation—the art of Kalpa. It explores the transformative alchemy of processing raw botanical ingredients into potent, standardized therapeutic preparations. Through themes of purification, extraction, and complex compounding, this section establishes the foundational principles of ancient pharmaceutics.

chapters.abstract: This chapter deals with pharmaceutical preparations of Madana (Randia dumatorum), also known as Madanaphala. It serves as the introductory chapter to Kalpa Sthana, explaining the objectives of the section and the fundamental concepts of Vamana (therapeutic emesis) and Virechana (therapeutic purgation). The chapter describes the pharmacodynamics of emetic and purgative drugs, their mode of action, and the criteria for their classification.
keyConcepts: Pharmacodynamics of emetic drugs - ushna, tikshna, sukshma, vyavayi, vikashi properties
Doshahara property - upper and lower channel elimination
chapters.summary: Madanakalpa Adhyaya introduces the fundamental concepts of pharmaceutical preparations in Ayurveda. The chapter begins by stating the objective of Kalpa Sthana - to describe preparations of emetic and purgative drugs, their combinations, and easy methods of administration. It defines Vamana as elimination of doshas from the upper part of the body and Virechana from the lower part. The pharmacodynamics explain how drugs with ushna (hot), tikshna (sharp), sukshma (subtle), vyavayi (pervasive), and vikashi (spreading) properties act by reaching the heart, circulating through vessels, and affecting dosha masses throughout the body. The direction of drug action (upward for emesis, downward for purgation) is determined by the predominance of certain mahabhutas - agni and vayu for upward movement, jala and prithvi for downward movement.

importantVerses.sanskrit: अथ खलु वमनविरेचनार्थं वमनविरेचनद्रव्याणां सुखोपभोगतमैः सहान्यैर्द्रव्यैर्विविधैः कल्पनार्थं भेदार्थं विभागार्थं चेत्यर्थः
importantVerses.translation: Now I shall expound the section on pharmaceuticals that deals with preparations of emetic and purgative drugs, describing combinations and administration of these formulations.
Of all drugs, those that eliminate impurities from the upper part are known as emetics while those that act via the lower part are called purgatives.

importantVerses.sanskrit: तत्रोष्ण-तीक्ष्ण-सूक्ष्म-व्यवायि-विकाशीन्यौषधानि स्ववीर्येण हृदयमुपेत्य धमनीरनुसृत्य स्थूलाणुस्रोतोभ्यः केवलं शरीरगतं दोषसङ्घातमाग्नेयत्वाद्विष्यन्दयन्ति
importantVerses.translation: The ushna, tikshna, sukshma, vyavayi and vikashi drugs, because of their vigorous ability in reaching the heart and circulating through the vessels, affect masses of impurity within the entire body, liquefying them.

formulations.name: Madanaphala Churna
formulations.preparation: Fruit is cleaned, dried and powdered

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the pharmaceutical preparations of Jimutaka (Luffa echinata), a potent emetic herb. Jimutaka is considered one of the main Vamana drugs and is particularly effective for Kapha-related disorders. The chapter provides detailed information about its identification, properties, formulations, and therapeutic applications.
chapters.summary: Jimutaka Kalpa Adhyaya focuses on the emetic drug Jimutaka (Luffa echinata). This herb is recognized for its potent Vamana (emetic) properties and is particularly effective in eliminating excess Kapha dosha. The chapter describes various formulations prepared from Jimutaka, including powders, decoctions, and medicated preparations. It discusses the specific indications for each formulation, considering the patient's condition, season, and constitution. The therapeutic applications extend beyond simple emesis to treat various disorders including cough, asthma, and cardiac conditions.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on Jimutaka preparations.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the pharmaceutical preparations of Ikshvaku (Lagenaria siceraria), also known as bottle gourd. Ikshvaku is an important Vamana drug used for therapeutic emesis. The chapter provides comprehensive details about its properties, formulations, and therapeutic applications in various diseases.
chapters.summary: Ikshvaku Kalpa Adhyaya discusses the preparations of Ikshvaku (Lagenaria siceraria), commonly known as bottle gourd. This vegetable is recognized for its medicinal properties and is used as a primary Vamana drug. The chapter details various formulations prepared from different parts of the plant - fruits, seeds, and leaves. It explains the therapeutic applications for treating Kapha-related disorders, respiratory conditions, and cardiac ailments. The preparations are designed to facilitate safe and effective therapeutic emesis.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on Ikshvaku preparations.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the pharmaceutical preparations of Dhamargava (Luffa cylindrica), also known as sponge gourd. Dhamargava is an important emetic drug used in Ayurveda for therapeutic purification. The chapter provides detailed information about its properties, formulations, and applications.
chapters.summary: Dhamargava Kalpa Adhyaya covers the pharmaceutical preparations of Dhamargava (Luffa cylindrica), commonly known as sponge gourd or loofah. This plant is recognized for its Vamana (emetic) properties and is used extensively in therapeutic purification procedures. The chapter details various methods of preparing the drug for different therapeutic purposes. It explains the indications, contraindications, and special considerations for different body types and disease conditions.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on Dhamargava preparations.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the pharmaceutical preparations of Vatsaka (Holarrhena antidysenterica), also known as kutaja or contry. Vatsaka is primarily a Virechana (purgative) drug and is extensively used in Ayurveda for treating intestinal disorders, especially diarrhea and dysentery.
chapters.summary: Vatsaka Kalpa Adhyaya focuses on the purgative drug Vatsaka (Holarrhena antidysenterica), commonly known as kutaja. This herb is one of the most important Virechana drugs in Ayurveda and is particularly effective for treating intestinal disorders. The chapter provides detailed information about various formulations prepared from the bark and seeds of the plant. It explains the specific applications for treating diarrhea, dysentery, irritable bowel syndrome, and other digestive conditions.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on Vatsaka preparations.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the pharmaceutical preparations of Kritavedhana (Citrullus colocynthis), also known as indicुम. Kritavedhana is a potent purgative drug used in Ayurveda for treating various disorders. The chapter provides detailed information about its properties, formulations, and therapeutic applications.
chapters.summary: Kritavedhana Kalpa Adhyaya discusses the purgative drug Kritavedhana (Citrullus colocynthis), also known as colocynth or indicum. This is one of the most potent purgative agents in Ayurveda, used primarily for therapeutic purgation and bowel cleansing. The chapter details various formulations and their specific applications for different disease conditions.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on Kritavedhana preparations.

chapters.abstract: This is one of the most extensive chapters in Kalpa Sthana, describing the pharmaceutical preparations of Shyama-Trivrita (Operculina turpethum), also known as trivrita or turpeth. This is a highly important and widely used purgative drug in Ayurveda. The chapter provides comprehensive details about its properties, numerous formulations, and diverse therapeutic applications.
chapters.summary: Shyamatrivrita Kalpa Adhyaya is a comprehensive chapter on Shyama-Trivrita (Operculina turpethum), one of the most important purgative drugs in Ayurveda. The chapter extensively describes various formulations including powders, ghee preparations, oils, decoctions, semi-solids, and confections. It explains the therapeutic applications for treating numerous conditions including constipation, digestive disorders, fever, skin diseases, and neurological conditions. The detailed formulations and preparation methods make this chapter extremely valuable for practical pharmacy.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on Shyama-Trivrita preparations.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the pharmaceutical preparations of Chaturangula (Cassia fistula), also known as aragwadha or golden shower tree. Chaturangula is an important purgative drug used in Ayurveda. The chapter provides detailed information about its properties, formulations, and therapeutic applications.
chapters.summary: Chaturangula Kalpa Adhyaya covers the purgative drug Chaturangula (Cassia fistula), commonly known as aragwadha or golden shower tree. The plant is used extensively in Ayurvedic pharmacy for its purgative properties. Various parts of the plant - fruits, flowers, and bark - are utilized in different formulations. The chapter describes the therapeutic applications for treating digestive disorders, fever, skin conditions, and other ailments.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on Chaturangula preparations.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the pharmaceutical preparations of Tilvaka (Symplocos racemosa), also known as lodhra. Tilvaka is primarily a Virechana drug used in Ayurveda for treating various disorders. The chapter provides comprehensive details about its properties, formulations, and applications.
chapters.summary: Tilvaka Kalpa Adhyaya discusses the purgative drug Tilvaka (Symplocos racemosa), commonly known as lodhra. This herb is recognized for its purgative and blood-purifying properties. The chapter details various formulations and their specific applications for treating skin disorders, pitta-related conditions, and blood-related diseases.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on Tilvaka preparations.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the pharmaceutical preparations of Sudha, which refers to various alkaline substances used in Ayurveda. Sudha drugs include different types of alkali preparations used as purgatives and for other therapeutic purposes.
chapters.summary: Sudha Kalpa Adhyaya covers the pharmacological preparations of various alkaline substances (Sudha) used in Ayurveda. These include different types of alkali preparations derived from plants and minerals. The chapter details their purgative properties and applications in purification therapies.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on Sudha preparations.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the pharmaceutical preparations of Saptala (Euphorbia retusa) and Shankhini (Euphorbia pilosa), two important purgative drugs in Ayurveda. These drugs are known for their potent Virechana properties and are used in various formulations.
chapters.summary: Saptalashankhini Kalpa Adhyaya covers two important purgative drugs - Saptala and Shankhini (both species of Euphorbia). These are potent purgative agents used in therapeutic purification. The chapter provides detailed information about their identification, properties, formulations, and specific therapeutic applications.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on Saptala-Shankhini preparations.

chapters.abstract: This is the largest chapter in Kalpa Sthana, describing the pharmaceutical preparations of Danti (Baliospermum montanum) and Dravanti (Baliospermum axillare). These are extremely important purgative drugs in Ayurveda, known for their potent Virechana properties. The chapter provides exhaustive details about numerous formulations and their applications.
chapters.summary: Dantidravanti Kalpa Adhyaya is the most extensive chapter in Kalpa Sthana, covering Danti and Dravanti (Baliospermum species). These are among the most potent purgative drugs in Ayurveda. The chapter provides exhaustive details about numerous formulations - powders, ghee, oils, decoctions, semi-solids, and confections. It explains their applications for treating various disorders including digestive issues, fever, skin diseases, neurological conditions, and many more. The detailed formulations and preparation methods make this chapter invaluable for Ayurvedic pharmacy.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on Danti-Dravanti preparations.

sthanas.description: Siddhi-sthana is the crowning jewel of Charaka Samhita, representing the pinnacle of healing mastery. While earlier chapters focus on pathology and diagnosis, Siddhi-sthana explores the art of perfection - the successful culmination of therapeutic practice. It delves into profound themes of detoxification, Panchakarma procedures, complications management, and the science of therapeutic success.

chapters.abstract: This chapter provides a comprehensive summary of Panchakarma (five purification therapies) - Vamana, Virechana, Basti, Nasya, and Raktamokshana. It describes the standard administration procedures, indications, contraindications, and outcomes of each therapy. The chapter serves as an introduction to the therapeutic procedures detailed in Siddhi Sthana.
chapters.summary: Kalpana Siddhi provides a comprehensive overview of Panchakarma therapies. The chapter explains the five main purification procedures - Vamana (therapeutic emesis), Virechana (therapeutic purgation), Basti (therapeutic enema), Nasya (nasal administration), and Raktamokshana (bloodletting). It details the preparatory procedures (purva karma), main procedures (pradhana karma), and post-therapy care (paschat karma). The chapter emphasizes proper patient assessment, seasonal considerations, and outcomes evaluation for successful therapy.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on standard administration of purification procedures.

chapters.abstract: This chapter provides an overview of Panchakarma therapies, describing the indications, procedures, and outcomes for each of the five purification therapies. It explains the selection criteria for different therapies based on patient condition and disease characteristics.
chapters.summary: Panchakarmiya Siddhi provides an overview of the five Panchakarma therapies. The chapter explains the specific indications for each therapy based on the disease type, patient constitution, and season. It details the procedures and outcomes expected from properly administered therapies.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on successful administration of Panchakarma therapies.

chapters.abstract: This chapter is one of the most important in Siddhi Sthana, providing detailed information about Basti (therapeutic enema) therapy. It describes the types of Basti, formulations, administration procedures, indications, contraindications, and complications management. Basti is considered the most important therapy for Vata disorders.
keyConcepts: Types of Basti - Niruha and Anuvasana
chapters.summary: Bastisutriyam Siddhi is an extensive chapter on Basti (therapeutic enema), one of the most important therapies in Ayurveda. The chapter provides comprehensive details about different types of Basti - Niruha (decoction enema) and Anuvasana (oil enema). It explains the formulations, administration procedures, indications, contraindications, and complications management. Basti is particularly important for Vata disorders and is considered the main therapy for balancing Vata dosha.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on standard practices of Basti (therapeutic enema).

formulations.name: Niruha Basti
formulations.ingredients: Decoction of various herbs, salt, oil, honey

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the complications that can occur during and after Snehana (oleation therapy) and their successful management. It provides detailed information about various complications and their treatment protocols.
chapters.summary: Snehavyapat Siddhi deals with the complications that can occur during and after oleation therapy (Snehana). The chapter provides detailed information about various complications that may arise from improper or excessive oleation, their diagnosis, and treatment protocols for managing these complications effectively.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on complications of unctuous enema and their successful management.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the complications that can occur due to improper use of instruments in Basti therapy, particularly concerning the Basti netra (enema nozzle). It provides guidance on preventing and managing these complications.
chapters.summary: Netrabastivyapat Siddhi focuses on complications that arise from improper use of instruments during Basti therapy. The chapter specifically addresses issues related to the Basti netra (enema nozzle) and provides guidance on safe administration techniques and complication management.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on management of complications due to enema nozzle.

chapters.abstract: This is one of the largest chapters in Siddhi Sthana, describing the complications that can occur during and after Vamana (therapeutic emesis) and Virechana (therapeutic purgation) therapies. It provides comprehensive information on complication prevention, diagnosis, and management.
chapters.summary: Vamana Virechana Vyapat Siddhi is an extensive chapter covering complications of therapeutic emesis (Vamana) and purgation (Virechana). It provides comprehensive details about various complications that can occur during and after these therapies, their diagnosis, and management protocols. The chapter covers complications from excessive, inadequate, and improper administration, along with emergency management protocols.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on management of complications of improper therapeutic emesis and purgation.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the complications that can occur during Basti (therapeutic enema) therapy and their management. It provides detailed information about various complications and their treatment protocols.
chapters.summary: Bastivyapat Siddhi covers complications that can occur during Basti (therapeutic enema) therapy. The chapter provides detailed information about various complications arising from improper administration, excessive or inadequate therapy, and their management protocols.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on management of complications of therapeutic enema.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes specialized Basti formulations prepared using the Prasrita (specific dose unit) method. It provides detailed information about various specialized enema preparations and their therapeutic applications.
chapters.summary: Prasrita Yogiyam Siddhi describes specialized Basti formulations prepared using the Prasrita method. These are specific dose enema preparations used for various therapeutic purposes. The chapter provides detailed information about the formulations, preparation methods, and their specific applications.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on standardized therapeutic enema formulations in a dose of Prasrita Unit.

chapters.abstract: This is the largest chapter in Siddhi Sthana, describing the management of diseases affecting the three vital organs - Hridaya (heart), Shiras (head), and Basti (bladder/kidney). It provides comprehensive information about diseases of these organs and their treatment.
chapters.summary: Trimarmiya Siddhi is the largest chapter in Siddhi Sthana, dealing with diseases of the three vital organs - Hridaya (heart), Shiras (head), and Basti (bladder/kidney). The chapter provides comprehensive information about various disorders affecting these organs, their diagnosis, and treatment protocols.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on management of diseases of three vital organs.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the criteria for successful Basti therapy and the outcomes expected from properly administered enema treatment. It provides guidance on achieving optimal therapeutic results.
chapters.summary: Basti Siddhi describes the criteria for successful Basti therapy. The chapter explains the signs and outcomes that indicate proper administration and successful therapeutic results from enema treatment.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on successful administration of therapeutic enema.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes the utility of medicinal fruits and other factors in therapeutic enema formulations. It provides information about fruit-based Basti preparations and their therapeutic applications.
chapters.summary: Phalamatra Siddhi discusses the utility of medicinal fruits in therapeutic enema formulations. The chapter provides information about various fruit-based Basti preparations and their specific therapeutic applications.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on utility of medicinal fruits and other factors in standard therapeutic enema.

chapters.abstract: This chapter describes Uttar Basti - a specialized local enema therapy administered through the urethra in males or vagina in females. It provides detailed information about this therapy, its indications, procedures, and applications.
chapters.summary: Uttar Basti Siddhi describes Uttar Basti - a specialized local enema therapy. This therapy is administered through the urethra in males or vagina in females for local treatment of disorders in these areas. The chapter provides comprehensive information about the procedure, indications, formulations, and safety considerations.

importantVerses.translation: Now we shall expound the chapter on standard administration of best effective therapeutic enema.
